facts.fact: Minister Pius Mokgware told Parliament the ministry is developing an Electronic Identification (Digital ID) system for secure verification and authentication across public and private services, with digital signatures, a pilot by end-2025 and full rollout targeted by end-2026.

BWA.note: Nothing on civil register and ID links.
Only plans to digitise permit and visa processing; no service stated as launched or piloted.
No enrolment count or share given.
Nothing on who operates or owns the ID system.
No public register keyed on the ID number is described.

facts.fact: Minister Pius Mokgware told Parliament the ministry is developing an Electronic Identification system as a single source of identity for citizens and residents, integrating the Omang, passports and driver's licences, with a pilot by end-2025 and full rollout by end-2026.

BWA.note: Only a plan for the digital ID to support eKYC and verification; no specific system linked, contracted or piloted.
No law or draft on data sharing is mentioned.
